Subject: SaaSCo outage on 2026-03-01 — Root Cause & next steps

Hi Daniel — thank you again for your patience while we completed our investigation. Below is a concise summary of what happened, the timeline, and concrete actions Redwood Inference is committing to. I've attached a one-page PDF RCA and a supplemental timeline for your records.

Short RCA summary (one line):
On 2026-03-01 at ~02:30 UTC a cascading cache eviction combined with a delayed autoscaling action caused sustained queueing on one of the GPU pools serving your traffic, producing elevated latency and a subset of 5xx errors for approximately 42 minutes.

Impact:
- Window: 2026-03-01 02:30 UTC — 03:12 UTC (42 minutes).
- Customer-facing effect: ~8% of calls returned 5xx or timed out; retrying recovered many requests.
- No customer data was exfiltrated or modified. Logs show normal access patterns.

Detailed timeline (selected events):
- 2026-03-01 02:23 UTC — Routine model cache rotation started on Pool-3 (controlled eviction to refresh embeddings).
- 2026-03-01 02:27 UTC — Autoscaler observed increased queue depth but retried a control-plane API call during a transient rate-limit; scale action delayed by ~90s.
- 2026-03-01 02:30 UTC — Cache eviction progressed, increasing KV cache misses; CPU/GPU scheduling delayed new requests, queue grew.
- 2026-03-01 02:34 UTC — Error rates in Pool-3 spike to 15% for routed traffic. Automated routing policy initiated progressive failover to Pool-1.
- 2026-03-01 03:01 UTC — Emergency scale-up triggered successfully; new hosts accepted traffic.
- 2026-03-01 03:12 UTC — Error rates normalized; full recovery confirmed by health checks.

Immediate mitigations (what we did):
- Rerouted traffic away from affected pool within 4 minutes of detection.
- Emergency scale-up completed and health checks validated services by 03:12 UTC.
- We verified logs and confirmed no data integrity concerns.

Actions we are taking (commitments & timelines):
1) Short-term (by 2026-03-10): implement a 2-minute aggressive fallback window for all production routing policies to reduce impact window during cache churn.
2) Short-term (by 2026-03-12): add a control-plane retry backoff improvement to reduce autoscaler control-plane API retry collisions.
3) Mid-term (by 2026-04-01): add enhanced pre-eviction checks and predictive cache warming for the model cache rotation process.
4) We will schedule a joint postmortem call with your SREs to walk the timeline and verify acceptance of our mitigation plan. Proposed time: Wed 2026-03-10 10:00 PST (link below).

Attachments: [attachment: SaaSCo_RCA_2026-03-03.pdf (PDF, 54KB)], [attachment: SaaSCo_timeline_appendix.csv (CSV, 7KB)]

Meeting: https://meet.redwood.com/marissa/saasco-followup

Please let me know if you'd like us to change the cadence or add a pre-call with your infra team. We're committed to ensuring this won't repeat.

Best regards,
